warnings.headline: Official WARNING of FROST
warnings.description:
There is a risk of frost (level 1 of 2).
Minimum temperature: -1 - -5 °C
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) to expect: possible frost damage. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
If necessary, take precautions against frost.

warnings.headline: Yellow Dense fog warning for Poland - Dolnoslaskie Province Boleslawiecki County
warnings.description: It is forecasted dense fog with very poor visibility - locally below 200 m. In some places, fog may freeze, roads and sidewalks could be slippery.
warnings.instruction: BE AWARE of some widespread, locally dense fog. May strongly affect outdoor routines. Can cause airport closures and delays, difficult driving conditions and longer journey times.
